_how_to: public_endpoint: fixed public https base URL (e.g. a named Cloudflare tunnel), without /api/tip; takes precedence. quick_tunnel: true = run.sh keeps a Cloudflare quick tunnel watchdog running (tunnel.sh; random *.trycloudflare.com URL in tunnel-url.txt, cleared when down). tip_page_uses_server: only decides what tip-endpoint.json holds; it does not change /tip/. /tip/ opens the private inbox form (tipworker POST /api/private-tip) only when public_endpoint and turnstile_site_key (public Turnstile site key; else chat/config.json's key) are both set, and never falls back to a GitHub issue. auto_publish_endpoint: true = tunnel.sh/run.sh push tip-endpoint.json to gh-pages whenever the URL changes; false = only site/tip-endpoint.json is updated locally. Set tip_page_uses_server and auto_publish_endpoint to true ONLY after jQrgen approves the tip page.
